purpose: The home hero: a two-tone h1, a copyright stamp, a scroll cue, a two-row label marquee, a local-only upload dropzone and an 8-photograph rotating ring.

headingAccent.note: Measured: 2 words, "instantly re-shot.", in a .u-fonts-50 span inside the same h1. The two-tone h1 is the site's signature heading treatment.

copyrightYear.note: Measured: the literal "2026", injected at runtime by public/motion/m03.js from [data-current-year].

sliderItems.note: Exactly 6, measured 1-2 words each: PDPs, UGC, Lifestyle shots, Ads, Stories, Street style. Duplicated into a second identical row to make the marquee seamless.

uploadPrompt.note: Measured: 5 words, "Upload or drop your assets".

alt.note: Required on every content image. Measured 3-27 words across the real images (longest: a 27-word hero carousel description); the four decorative preloader images ship alt="", which is why the empty string is allowed. alt is accessibility text, not visible page copy, so it carries its own budget but is excluded from contentMaxWordsTotal.

evidence.structure: Structure, layout and motion measured against the live original. A pixel audit verified 1382/1382 elements at a 1440px viewport and 962/962 at 390px with zero deltas. Copy is the original's own.

constraints.verification: src/pages/Home.jsx:12 renders <Hero /> as the first child of <Layout>. Checked against all 5 real templates: it appears only in `home`, at the first body position immediately after chrome.menu.

motion.detail: public/motion/m25.js reveals every [data-hero-text] element with a 0.2 stagger and honours a data-final-opacity attribute, so some words deliberately settle at 0.5 rather than 1. The .hero__slider__row CSS marquee runs 24s linear infinite. m17.js rotates .hero__carousel__in 360 degrees over 32s (ease none, repeat -1) and m18.js counter-rotates each image so the photographs stay upright. m16.js binds the dropzone.
motion.reducedMotionFallback: Show the h1, the copyright stamp and the scroll cue at their final opacity with no stagger; freeze the label marquee and the photograph ring at their initial frames; keep the dropzone fully interactive.
motion.reducedMotionFallbackKind: design-rule (the source ships NO prefers-reduced-motion handling for this section, so the fallback is prescribed by this repository, not mirrored)

responsive.max-991px: the label marquee FLIPS to HORIZONTAL (--tx-end: -100%) and heading.page drops 5.5rem -> 4.5rem
responsive.max-767px: heading.page drops to 2.5rem; the marquee stays horizontal

contentMaxWordsTotalNote: Set BETWEEN the measured real total and the maximum the per-field budgets allow, so the cap can actually reject an over-long instance instead of being unreachable. extraction/verify_all.py check [p] fails if any declared contentMaxWordsTotal becomes vacuous (>= the per-field maximum). Previously 35, which was unreachable.
